basis.scope_boundary: The ratified change has code_surface: none. Its owner roles govern planning. Successor decisions establish runtime repository placement, file scope, verification and releases.

neutral_binding.candidate_scope: Optional domain-neutral runtime binding, approval and enrollment references, conformance and evidence semantics.

installer.candidate_scope: Install or connect customer-operated Headscale and select an authorized managed network. Verify compatibility for existing unbound installations.

ops.candidate_scope: Operating procedures for policy, scoped routes, enrollment, revocation, upgrade, backup, quarantine and recovery.

headscale_install.candidate_scope: Repeatable customer-operated and managed Headscale installation, pinned releases, instance lifecycle, backups and verification.

hosted_product.candidate_scope: Independent entitlement, customer-scoped managed provisioning, attachment and revocation, hosted onboarding and catalog admission.

hosted_domain.candidate_scope: Declare minimum access and qualify each domain profile. Use the generic synthetic profile for the common onboarding pilot.
hosted_domain.repository_status: pilot profile sponsor and runtime repository pending

evidence_tooling.candidate_scope: Feature-local validation of redacted pilot evidence and prerequisite gate records.

Its merged scope is policy and handoff. GitHub returned HTTP 404 for the tested proposed install and product slugs. These checks cover the repositories and records visible to the authenticated account.
